DEFINITION · qeva:1:optimization@1

Optimization

Optimization seeks feasible points minimizing or maximizing an objective function.

editorialoptimization · analysis · algorithms

PLAIN

The idea

Optimization asks which allowed state scores best according to an explicit objective.

EXACT

The compact statement

A minimization problem is inf_{x∈X} f(x); a global minimizer x* satisfies f(x*)≤f(x) for all x∈X.

EXAMPLE

Minimize (x-3)^2 over R; the unique global minimizer is x=3.

BOUNDARY / CAVEAT

An optimization objective encodes what is valued. Mathematical optimality does not imply the objective itself is appropriate.

ASSUMPTIONS

  • A feasible set X and objective f:X→R or ordered codomain are specified.

PROVENANCE

Seed record for the QEVA machinery map. It is not claimed to be the unique foundational presentation of this concept.
